title: test flake: StudioDesignSurface.publishBackfill-12929 reads the counted backfill checkbox synchronously after opening the sheet (ejected PR #13117 from the merge queue)
body:
## Problem

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.publishBackfill-12929.test.tsx` › "unchecked: the publish names no field, so nothing is written into existing rows" failed in a merge group on a tree identical to a green run. It ejected PR #13117:
- merge-group run 39367006901, `Test (shard 12/16)`;
- the tree was objectui `main` `4b67746498` plus PR #13117. PR #13117's own CI on the same base passed every shard, and `main` CI at `4b67746498` is green.

The failure: `TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an accessible element with the role "checkbox" and name /\b12\b/`, with the "Pending changes" sheet open.

## Likely cause (source reading)

Line 231 reads the checkbox **synchronously** right after `openSheet()`: `within(sheet).getByRole('checkbox', { name: new RegExp(\`\\b${N}\\b\`) })`. The checkbox's accessible name carries the existing-row count `N` (12), which the sheet fills from an asynchronous read. On a slow runner the sheet is open before the count lands, so the synchronous `getBy` misses it.

## Target

The test waits for the counted checkbox (`findByRole`, or `openSheet()` resolving only once the count is drawn), without weakening the assertion. Check the file's other cases for the same synchronous read.

Surface: the one test file (objectui#12929's, PR #13090 `6058bf8b71`).

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`), who found the flake (merge-queue ejection of PR #13117).
